{"sql":"-- 1) Find the maximum number of playlists any track appears in
SELECT MAX(playlist_count) AS max_playlists
FROM (
  SELECT pt.TrackId, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS playlist_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack pt
  GROUP BY pt.TrackId
) sub;"}

tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"-- 2) List all tracks that appear in that maximum number of playlists with their names
WITH track_playlist_counts AS (
  SELECT pt.TrackId, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS playlist_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack pt
  GROUP BY pt.TrackId
)
SELECT t.TrackId, t.Name, t.Composer, t.UnitPrice, t.Milliseconds, tc.playlist_count
FROM track_playlist_counts tc
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = tc.TrackId
WHERE tc.playlist_count = (
  SELECT MAX(playlist_count) FROM track_playlist_counts
)
ORDER BY t.Name
;"}

SELECT MAX(playlist_count) AS max_playlists
FROM (
  SELECT pt.TrackId, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS playlist_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack pt
  GROUP BY pt.TrackId

WITH track_playlist_counts AS (
  SELECT pt.TrackId, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS playlist_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack pt

)
SELECT t.TrackId, t.Name, t.Composer, t.UnitPrice, t.Milliseconds, tc.playlist_count
FROM track_playlist_counts tc
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = tc.TrackId
WHERE tc.playlist_count = (
  SELECT MAX(playlist_count) FROM track_playlist_counts
)
ORDER BY t.Name
